description: Cowabunga! Little heroes can hit the streets in style with the Dynacraft Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 12V Motorcycle Ride-On Toy for Kids. Built for action-packed fun, this battery-powered electric motorcycle combines premium features with the bold look of the iconic TMNT team. Designed with training wheels for extra stability, this ride-on helps kids build balance and confidence while enjoying safe, steady rides. Powered by a 12V rechargeable battery, this motorized ride-on bike delivers up to 45 minutes of continuous playtime per charge, with a top speed of 3 MPH for every adventure. The twist-grip throttle offers two speed settings so little riders can level up as they grow. With durable steel-and-plastic construction, this ride-on motorcycle is made to handle hours of backyard missions, driveway races, and neighborhood patrols. Kids will love the realistic motocross styling featuring high-rise handlebars, detailed fenders, and engine accents that bring the excitement of the open road to life. Finished in the bold Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles color palette of green, purple, and black, this ride-on makes every mission feel like an epic TMNT adventure. Perfect for ages 3 and up, the TMNT 12V motorcycle ride-on toy makes an unforgettable gift for young fans ready to join their favorite ninja heroes.
